summary: The filing (Form 424B5) is a preliminary prospectus supplement for a registered follow-on offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants by Q32 Bio Inc., a pharmaceutical company. The offering seeks up to $200M in gross proceeds, with an underwriters' option for an additional $30M. Price per share is not yet set but the last sale was $11.21. The securities are being offered via underwriters (Morgan Stanley, Jefferies, Cantor, Oppenheimer, H.C. Wainwright). This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation.
